title: Pendulums are the most common artifact in Egypt

tellings.quote: If you go to Egypt and you dig in the soil there, the most artifacts that they find under the ground in Egypt are pendulums.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs have been drawn to him for years, says that when people dig in the soil of Egypt, the most common ancient object they find is the pendulum, a weight hung on a cord. He passes it on from a teacher named Robert Gilbert. If true, it would hint that the ancient Egyptians used pendulums for some important everyday purpose.
